datasheet.title: LM27761 Low-Noise, Regulated, Switched-Capacitor Voltage Inverter

notes: Negative output limits retain their sign and are ordered numerically: -5 V minimum, -1.5 V maximum.
Recommended output current (0.25 A) is separate from the absolute-maximum continuous current (0.3 A).
The regulator is a charge-pump inverter with a following negative LDO. No numeric switch-current limit is extracted because this table does not specify one.

input_voltage.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

output_voltage.conditions: VIN = 5 V; C1 to C4 as in Typical Application; typical at TA = 25 degC, limits over the full operating temperature range. VIN = 2.7 to 5.5 V.

output_current.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

operating_ambient_temperature.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

operating_junction_temperature.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

input_voltage_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

output_current_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

source.row: Continuous output current, CPOUT and VOUT

junction_temperature_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

storage_temperature.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

feedback_reference_voltage.conditions: VIN = 5 V; C1 to C4 as in Typical Application; typical at TA = 25 degC, limits over the full operating temperature range.

switching_frequency.conditions: VIN = 5 V; C1 to C4 as in Typical Application; typical at TA = 25 degC, limits over the full operating temperature range. VIN = 3.6 V instead of 5 V.

quiescent_current.conditions: VIN = 5 V; C1 to C4 as in Typical Application; typical at TA = 25 degC, limits over the full operating temperature range. Open circuit, no load.

shutdown_current.conditions: VIN = 5 V; C1 to C4 as in Typical Application; typical at TA = 25 degC, limits over the full operating temperature range.

ldo_dropout_voltage.conditions: VIN = 5 V; C1 to C4 as in Typical Application; typical at TA = 25 degC, limits over the full operating temperature range. ILOAD = 0.1 A, VOUT = -5 V.

output_noise_voltage.conditions: VIN = 5 V; C1 to C4 as in Typical Application; typical at TA = 25 degC, limits over the full operating temperature range. ILOAD = 0.08 A; integrated over 10 Hz to 100 kHz.
output_noise_voltage.notes: RMS noise voltage, converted from uV RMS to V RMS; not peak-to-peak ripple.

ldo_psrr.conditions: VIN = 5 V; C1 to C4 as in Typical Application; typical at TA = 25 degC, limits over the full operating temperature range. ILOAD = 0.08 A, VCPOUT = -5 V; at 2 MHz per page 1 feature summary.
